enchantment.runeforged.fire.desc: Adds Fire damage: burns the target over time and lowers its Frost and Physical Resistance.
enchantment.runeforged.holy.desc: Adds Holy damage: stronger against undead, with a chance to restore your health.
enchantment.runeforged.lightning.desc: Adds Lightning damage: a chance to call down a lightning strike for extra damage.
enchantment.runeforged.low_temperature.d: Adds Frost damage: chills and slows the target, and can stop Creeper explosions.
